analysis_md:
由题意知，方程组确定隐函数组 $x=x(u,v),y=y(u,v)$

在题设方程两边对 $u$ 求偏导得：
$$
2u-2x\cdot\frac{\partial x}{\partial u}-\frac{\partial y}{\partial u}=0,\quad
-1-\frac{\partial x}{\partial u}\cdot y-x\cdot\frac{\partial y}{\partial u}=0
$$
利用克莱姆法则，解得：
$$
\frac{\partial x}{\partial u}=\frac{2xu+1}{2x^2-y},\quad
\frac{\partial y}{\partial u}=-\frac{2x+2yu}{2x^2-y}
$$
